name: Lalu Atlas - keep line items in step with deal discounts

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'hs_lastmodifieddate', operator: 'GTE', value: String(Date.now() - 20*60*1000) }, { propertyName: 'pipeline', operator: 'IN', values: ['default','2298660077'] }] }], properties: ['size_discount','speed_discount','term_length_discount','referral_discount','amount'], limit: 100 }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return ($input.first().json.results || []).map(d => ({ json: { dealId: d.id, deal: d.properties } }));

const deals = $('One item per deal').all();
return $input.all().map((it, i) => ({ json: { dealId: deals[i].json.dealId, deal: deals[i].json.deal, ids: (it.json.results || []).map(r => String(r.toObjectId)) } })).filter(x => x.json.ids.length);
